owner_and_capability: Audit Platform publishes its own records (decision A of #4004, audit family of #4085): models/audit moves unchanged to modules/auditlog/records, classified as the owner's port, and the root binds it directly instead of through modules/auditlog/compose/vocabulary, which is deleted. The grade transition, staff offboarding and student deletion workflow compositions stop building the Audit command and the Audit records themselves: they take the Audit owner's append command as a consumer-owned AuditLog port and root-built record constructors (api/workflow_audits.go); the root builds the default command over the Audit owner's tenant persistence. Workforce's shift-move audit moves to the root as well (api.NewShiftMoveAudit over workforce.ShiftMovedEvent). The legacy models test's audit-record shape check moves into the records package.
affected_tables: None: the same ledgers append and read the same rows; only the package names of the records and the package that builds the command move.
atomic_cutover: One PR. models/audit is renamed to modules/auditlog/records (package records, content unchanged) and every importer follows the path. The workflow compositions drop their models/audit, database/repositories/audit and services/audit imports: each takes Audit (an Append(ctx, any) port the Audit command satisfies) and the record builders the root defines with the same field values, deletion types, metadata and tenant stamping the compositions used. The default ambient-transaction command, previously built inside each composition over database/repositories/audit.NewAppender, is built by the root over auditCompose.NewTenantPersistence(db, false).AppendStore with the same error-only log message, so a failed append still fails the workflow. The student deletion's audit-reference count uses the same repository over the Audit tenant persistence. Booking consistency takes its People Directory and Care Plan collaborators at construction instead of two post-construction binders. The 11 keys leave legacy.jsonl.

modules/peopledirectory/contracttest: the staff offboarding scenarios (including the failing-audit rollback) and the student deletion workflow over the owners built by api.NewStaffOffboardingOwners and api.NewStudentDeletionOwners, assertions unchanged.
modules/peopledirectory/inbound/students, api retention and grade transition helpers: the deletion and transition routes, assertions unchanged.
modules/workforce/internal/planning and workflows/shiftplansync/compose: the shift move audit suites through api.NewShiftMoveAudit, assertions unchanged.
modules/auditlog/records: TestFormerModelGetterExceptionsHaveHonestShapes moved from models with the same six cases and checks.

runtime_evidence.thresholds: The suites pass with unchanged assertion strength and the architecture check reports no new violation and no stale baseline entry.
